Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner treated Wikipedia’s infobox credit (“Directed by Pete Michels”) as the reliable cue without reconciling role distinctions or conflicting evidence. IMDb’s full credits list Wesley (Wes) Archer as the director and Pete Michels as the supervising director. Relying on the single, conflicting Wikipedia entry at that point could have led to the wrong conclusion (Pete Michels) instead of the correct answer, Wes Archer.
